content.title: Boston Marathon 2025 - Live Stream
content.text: View the live stream and TV coverage details, results, entry lists and race day schedule for the 2025 Boston Marathon.The 129th Boston Marathon is scheduled for Monday, April 21, 2025, coinciding with the 250th anniversary of Patriots' Day, a Massachusetts state holiday commemorating the start of the American Revolutionary War. This historic race, organized by the Boston Athletic Association (B.A.A.), is the world's oldest annual marathon and one of the six World Marathon Majors.​LIVE STREAMING & TV COVERAGE:The United States Coverage: ESPN2 will provide live national coverage of the 129th Boston Marathon from 9:00 AM to 12:30 PM ET on Monday, April 21, 2025.Watch Live on ESPN 2Local Coverage (Boston Area): Viewers in the Boston area can tune in to WCVB Channel 5 (ABC) for exclusive, live coverage of the 2025 Boston Marathon beginning at 4:00 AM ET on Marathon Monday, April 21.Streaming Option: The marathon will be streamed live on the Very Local app — free to download on smartphones, tablets, and smart TVs. Just search for “Very Local” in your device’s app store.Regional Simulcast:Coverage will also be available across the region on WCVB’s Hearst Television sister stations:WMUR News 9 (ABC) – Manchester, NHWMTW Channel 8 (ABC) – Portland/Auburn, MEWPTZ NBC5 – Burlington, VT / Plattsburgh, NYINTERNATIONAL COVERAGE:Europe - EurosportAustralia - FloSportsCanada - TSN/RDSChina - SMGBrazil - ESPN BrazilLatin America and Caribbean - ESPN LATAM/SurIndia - Eurosport IndiaAfrica - SupersportIndonesia, Philippines, Timor Leste - EmtekIf you are unable to watch the meet in your location here is how to access live stream:Get a VPN (you can try Pure VPN here)Connect to server in Boston, United States and watch live Boston Marathon on WCVB Channel 5 (ABC).Start Times (US Eastern):6:00 a.m. ET – Military Marchers9:06 a.m. ET – Wheelchair Division – Men9:09 a.m. ET – Wheelchair Division – Women9:30 a.m. ET – Handcycle & Duo Participants9:37 a.m. ET – Professional Men9:47 a.m. ET – Professional Women9:50 a.m. ET – Para Athletics Divisions10:00 a.m. ET – Wave 110:25 a.m. ET – Wave 210:50 a.m. ET – Wave 311:15 a.m. ET – Wave 4
